name: agora_exterior
description: The sunlit stoa frontage of the ancient agora with bright Doric colonnades, red-tiled roofs, and cheerful market awnings opening to the square.

color_palette: Chalk White #F5F2E8 for limewashed walls, column highlights, and clean trim that matches the interior.
Limestone Beige #D8C7A2 for stone blocks, steps, and paving to link the exterior to the interior palette.
Terracotta #C65D3A for roof tiles, amphorae, and border tiles that feel warm and historic.
Cedar Brown #6E4B3A for wooden stall frames, cart wheels, doors, and benches.
Aegean Blue #2E86AB for fabric awnings, pottery accents, and simple wayfinding symbols.
Olive Green #6B8E23 for wreaths, garlands, and foliage details around the colonnade.
visual_style.architectural_style: Classical Greek stoa exterior with sturdy Doric columns, whitewashed limestone walls, and red terracotta rooflines facing an open market square. Light wooden stall frames tuck between columns with colorful linen awnings; simple painted symbols serve as signs for young readers.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Potted olive and fig trees cluster near the steps, with low laurel shrubs by statues and bases of columns. Sparrows flit between awnings, gentle doves perch on roof tiles, and friendly market cats lounge near the fish sellers.
materials: Whitewashed limestone and marble for columns, stylobate steps, and stoa walls.
Terracotta tiles and pottery for roofs, jars, lamps, and decorative borders.
Sun-bleached wood and rope for market stalls, carts, and awning frames.
Bronze fittings for scales, hinges, lamp stands, and door hardware.
